Reading A (base clause): no deposit; extension on the opening world = 6 days (cover 0: 1000 held, card only; visits +1; tenure +1; length 3+0+1+1 = 5; Sunday offset 1 → 6) → new expiry 2026-10-31, deposit_held 1000.00, one write. Records: one deposit, 1000.00 credit card on 2026-10-20; extension deposit owed 1940.25 → unmet. Resolving policy: purchase_ext_extension_deposit (pay_extension_deposit_9124466d, owner user, debit card).

- No parallel edges. Tool bodies check nothing.

### task_independent_derivation
Need/authorisation: Marisol Delgado asks the desk to extend the RAV4 hold "for as long as the store will give you" today, agent acting for her; she will pay any amount she is told herself by debit card. Persona hints no prerequisite unprompted (the deposit line is conditional on the agent's explanation).

Step A (owner=user, handed over) — pay_extension_deposit_9124466d(purchase_deal_id=e88c4d7b..., deposit_amount=1940.25)
- rate: Kessler Owner Rewards Gold, active → 0.04; returned check/ACH service payments in 24m: 1 (check, 2025-12-18) → +0.01; days left DAYS(10-21, 10-25) = 4 → (2,4] → +0.005; total 0.055 × 41260 = 2269.30.
- service spend 12m: 2025-12-09 517.06 + 2026-04-16 136.32 + 2026-08-11 378.03 = 1031.41 ≥ 1000 → 0.9 (2025-09-14 lines are 13 months back, excluded); deposits received 1000 / 41260 = 2.42% → 0.95.
- credited: the 1000.00 deposit is credit card → not credited → 0.
- 2269.30 × 0.9 × 0.95 − 0 = 1940.2515 → 1940.25. Deposit total 2940.25 ≤ 10000; debit card allowed; no card limit touched. Baseline-only: 0.05 × 41260 − 1000 = 1063.00.

Step B (root) — extend_vehicle_hold_21e7c68f(purchase_deal_id=e88c4d7b..., extension_days=7)
- held 2940.25 / 41260 = 7.13% (≥5%, <7.5%) with a collected-funds (debit) deposit → +1; customer-pay line-A labor rows in 12m: 2025-12-09, 2026-04-16, 2026-08-11 = 3 (2025-09-14 out — near-miss: 4 would give +2) → +1; account opened 2018-05-14, 101 whole months (≥60, <120) → +1; length 3 + 3 = 6.
- start: 2026-10-25 is a Sunday → start from Monday → offset 1; result 7 → new expiry 2026-11-01, count 1.
- Opening-world value (no deposit): 6. Baseline-only: 3.

Second reading (closest alternative, not excluded by any rule): "for as long as the store will give you" with max_hold_extensions 2 and no rule limiting extensions per request — after step B, a second extension owes no further deposit (rate 0.04+0.01+0 = 0.05 → 2063.00 × 0.9 × 0.85 = 1578.20, credited 1940.25 → 0.00) and moves 2026-11-01 (also a Sunday) by 7 more days to 2026-11-08, count 2. See T1-1.

**T1-3 — charter-global defects demonstrated on this world:** C2(b), C5, C9(a)(b)(d).
